note: Carried by Tree.Forest.pack (the reduction to product Haar on free links under root-fixing gauge invariance), LocalRatio, whose existence is proved by LocalH.Haar.actual, and Work.F05.load_eq/order_exposed. Differences: pack integrates out the tree links by a seam split followed by a two-sided Haar rearrangement of the free links, rather than by tree-ordered Haar translates, and the exponential-coordinate density is stated only on a chart ball.

snippet.text:
theorem pack (F : Config G f → X) (h : Integrable F (prior G f))
    (he : ∀ k : Site f → G.El, (∀ i, k (g.embed i)=1) → ∀ U,F (Lattice.gauge k U)=F U) :
    (∫ U : Config G f, F U ∂prior G f) = ∫ x : A.Slice G,F (A.drape x) ∂A.order G := by
  let M : Measure (↥A.trunks → G.El) := Measure.pi (fun _ => G.probHaar)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure M := by unfold M; infer_instance
  have hS : MeasurePreserving A.seam (prior G f) (M.prod (A.order G)) := by
    unfold prior M order
    convert! measurePreserving_piEquivPiSubtypeProd  (fun _ : Edge (Site f) => G.probHaar) (fun i => i∈A.trunks)
  rw [← hS.symm.integral_comp' F]
  have H : Integrable (fun x => F (A.seam.symm x)) (M.prod (A.order G)) :=
    (hS.symm.integrable_comp_emb A.seam.symm.measurableEmbedding).mpr h
  rw [integral_prod _ H]; clear H
  have hh (x : ↥A.trunks → G.El) : (∫ y,F (A.seam.symm (x,y))∂A.order G) = ∫ y,F (A.drape y) ∂A.order G := by
    let k := A.foldAt (A.seam.symm (x,(1:A.Slice G)))
    have HS : MeasurePreserving (A.rearrange k) (A.order G) (A.order G) :=
      measurePreserving_pi _ _ fun i : A.Free => G.preserve_two_sided (k i.val.1) ((k (i.val.1+step i.val.2))⁻¹)
    have hg (y : A.Slice G) : F (A.seam.symm (x,y))=F (A.drape (A.rearrange k y)) := by
      rw [← he k (fun x => A.fold_root _ x)]
      congr 1
      funext i; by_cases e : i∈A.trunks
      · have H : k=A.foldAt (A.seam.symm (x,y)) := A.names _ _ (fun z h ↦ by
          let t : ↥A.trunks := ⟨z,h⟩
          exact (congr_fun (congr_arg Prod.fst (A.seam.apply_symm_apply (x,(1:A.Slice G)))) t).trans (congr_fun (congr_arg Prod.fst (A.seam.apply_symm_apply (x,y))) t).symm)
        exact Eq.trans (by rw [H]; exact A.compress _ _ e) (A.on_tree _ ⟨i,e⟩).symm
      let t : A.Free := ⟨i,e⟩
      rw [show A.drape _ i = _ from A.off_tree (A.rearrange k y) t]
      change k i.1*A.seam.symm (x,y) i*(k _)⁻¹=k i.1*y t*(k _)⁻¹
      rw [show A.seam.symm (x,y) i = y t from congr_fun (congr_arg Prod.snd (A.seam.apply_symm_apply (x,y))) t]
    simp_rw [hg]
    exact HS.integral_comp' (fun x ↦ F (A.drape x))
  simp_rw [hh]; simp

proof_context.conclusion: For F invariant under gauge transformations fixing the block roots, the integral over all links against product Haar equals the integral over free links (tree links set to 1) against product Haar.

lemma load_eq (P : ChartRatio G) (y : AxisChart G B) :
    load B P y = P.scale ^ Fintype.card B.Free * toll B P y := by
  simp [load,toll,Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

proof_context.conclusion: The chart density on free links is scale^{n_e} * prod_e J(z_e).

structure LocalRatio (Ñ : ChartRatio G) : Prop where
  scale : 0 < Ñ.scale
  patch : 0 < Ñ.radius
  inject : Set.InjOn G.lieExp (Metric.ball 0 Ñ.radius)
  pos (x : G.Color) : x∈Metric.ball 0 Ñ.radius → 0 < Ñ.J x
  anchored : Ñ.J 0=1
  germ : ∀ x∈ Metric.ball (0:G.Color) Ñ.radius, ContDiffAt ℝ ω Ñ.J x
  borel : Measurable Ñ.J
  actual : Measure.map G.lieExp ((volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 Ñ.radius)).withDensity (fun x : G.Color => ENNReal.ofReal (Ñ.scale*Ñ.J x))) =
    G.probHaar.restrict (G.lieExp '' (Metric.ball 0 Ñ.radius))
  isOpen : IsOpen (G.lieExp '' (Metric.ball 0 Ñ.radius))

proof_context.conclusion: In exponential coordinates, probability Haar is the pushforward of scale*J(x)dx on a ball, with J(0)=1 and J>0.
